title: High-Performance Pro+
description: Designed to prove that you don't need a high-end gaming rig to experience Minecraft’s true visual potential. Engineered specifically for low-end devices and budget-friendly hardware.
body:
# Download Now & Let's Play! 💖

## High-Performance Pro+
**Beautiful Graphics. Unbeatable Performance. No Compromises.**

**High-Performance Pro+** is a premium optimization suite designed specifically to bring high-end visuals to low-end hardware. Built on the Fabric loader, this pack doesn't just make your game run faster—it makes it look stunning while doing so. 

By combining the raw power of **Sodium** with the industry-leading **Iris Shaders** engine and next-gen rendering optimizations, High-Performance Pro+ allows even budget-friendly devices to run shaders smoothly.
  


---  

## 🌟 The Iris & Visual Advantage
The centerpiece of this pack is a carefully tuned visual engine. Unlike older systems that heavy-load your CPU, our stack is built from the ground up for modern performance and striking aesthetics.
* **Shaders for Everyone:** Experience the breathtaking lighting of **MakeUp - Ultra Fast** and **E-LITE** with near-native performance.
* **Shadows & Atmosphere:** Enjoy realistic waving plants, water reflections, and dynamic shadows without the typical 50% drop in FPS.
* **Crisp Textures & Lighting:** Enhanced with **Prime's HD Textures FREE (32x)** for a sharper vanilla-plus feel, paired with **Better Lights** for smoother, more immersive ambient lighting.
* **Seamless Integration:** Fully compatible with the included Sodium suite for the most stable graphical experience available today.


![MakeUp - Ultra Fast Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cd0473cd996a771c644a091db5fe40d1c763d90.jpeg)
> Powered by MakeUp - Ultra Fast! 

---

## 🚀 Optimized Features

* **Next-Gen Performance:** Powered by **Sodium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **BadOptimizations** to eliminate micro-stuttering, accelerate HUD/GUI rendering, and maximize your frame rate.
* **Smart Engine Tweaks:** Includes **C2ME** (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine) to speed up world loading and **Dynamic FPS** to reduce power consumption when the game is minimized.
* **Enhanced Visuals & Utilities:** Features **Better Lanterns** for 3D aesthetics, a clean **FPS Display** to track gains, and **FLASHBACK** to safely record your gameplay sessions without sacrificing performance.
* **Advanced Control:** Use **Reese's Sodium Options** and **Sodium Extra** to customize every graphical detail, from cloud height to particle density.

---

## 📦 What’s Under the Hood?

| Component | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Iris Shaders** | The world's fastest shader loader for Fabric. |
| **Sodium Core** | Massive boosts to rendering speed and reduced CPU overhead. |
| **ImmediatelyFast** | Lightweight optimization mod that significantly speeds up immediate mode rendering (GUIs, text, particles). |
| **MakeUp - Ultra Fast** | A shader pack designed specifically for "potato" PCs. |
| **Prime's HD Textures (32x)** | High-definition, performance-friendly textures that elevate the game's look. |
| **FLASHBACK** | A highly optimized gameplay recording tool to capture your best moments. |
| **Better Lights** | Improves the game's ambient lighting mechanics for smoother gradients. |
| **C2ME** | Multi-threaded chunk loading to stop "world-hole" glitches *(Disabled by default)*.  
| **BadOptimizations** | Essential fixes for niche performance bottlenecks in the vanilla code. |
| **Mod Menu** | Easily manage and configure all included performance mods. |
| **Sound Physics Remastered** |Brings a whole new layer of immersion to your world with realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and echo effects. Sound now dynamically bounces, muffles, and absorbs depending on the blocks surrounding you (e.g., deep caves sound echoey, while wool-lined rooms muffle sound)|
| **Motschen's Better Leaves** | Better Leaves adds additional layers to leaf blocks, making them appear more bushy, dense and natural.| 
---

## 🛠️ Getting Started

1. **Simply download** the Modpack
2. Open your Modrinth App
3. On the left side panel, click the "**+**" icon to **Create New Instance**
4. In the **Create instance** dialog, select **Install modpack**
5. Click the **Import modpack** button and locate the **High-Performance Pro+ #.#.#.mrpack** (# means version number)
6. The necessary dependencies will automatically be downloaded for you! Wait for it to complete
7. Click the newly created instance (**optional**: update the icon)
8. Click the **Play** button on the upper right corner of the app and enjoy playing Minecraft!
